title: Right-sizing: heavily over-provisioned deployment with an unrequested sidecar
description: reports-api requests 2 CPU / 4Gi per pod and uses about 140m / 610Mi. A sidecar has no requests at all. One usage snapshot only, so a good answer asks for history before big changes.
prompt: Is the reports-api deployment in analytics sized right? We seem to be paying for far more capacity than it uses.

describes.deployment/analytics/reports-api:
Name: reports-api
Namespace: analytics
Replicas: 4 desired | 4 ready
Strategy: RollingUpdate

workloadResources.deployment/analytics/reports-api:
Right-sizing Deployment analytics/reports-api (requests/limits vs live usage):

Pod reports-api-6d9f7c8b5-k2x9a (QoS Burstable):
  [api] cpu: req=2.00 lim=4.00 use=140m | mem: req=4.00Gi lim=8.00Gi use=610Mi
     -> memory over-provisioned, usage 610Mi is <40% of request 4.00Gi; CPU over-provisioned, usage 140m is <40% of request 2.00
  [log-shipper] cpu: req=- lim=- use=12m | mem: req=- lim=- use=48Mi
     -> no resource requests set, the scheduler is blind to this container (Guaranteed/Burstable QoS impossible; risk of noisy-neighbour starvation); no memory limit, a leak can consume the node

Pod reports-api-6d9f7c8b5-m4tqz (QoS Burstable):
  [api] cpu: req=2.00 lim=4.00 use=155m | mem: req=4.00Gi lim=8.00Gi use=640Mi
     -> memory over-provisioned, usage 640Mi is <40% of request 4.00Gi; CPU over-provisioned, usage 155m is <40% of request 2.00
  [log-shipper] cpu: req=- lim=- use=12m | mem: req=- lim=- use=48Mi
     -> no resource requests set, the scheduler is blind to this container (Guaranteed/Burstable QoS impossible; risk of noisy-neighbour starvation); no memory limit, a leak can consume the node
(showing 2 of 4 pods)
Guidance: set requests near steady-state usage (with headroom); a memory limit below peak usage risks OOMKill; requests far above usage waste schedulable capacity. Confirm with 1-2 weeks of history before large changes.

mustMatch.desc: cites the measured request vs usage figures
does not treat one snapshot as proof: asks for peak / percentile / history and keeps headroom
notes the log-shipper sidecar has no requests
